# bash: pushd/popd instead of cd in scripts

Review every `cd` in the scripts and replace the ones that only step into a directory temporarily with `pushd`/`popd` (see the [opensource.com article](https://opensource.com/article/19/8/navigating-bash-shell-pushd-popd)). The repository notes record the insight: `for dir in $(ls); do (cd $dir; run some action); done` forks a subshell per directory, while `pushd $dir; run some action; popd` does not, and keeps the directory stack visible.
